    The retained coefficients are nonzero (Proposition 12.8, a_i ∈ k^*) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "Specializing t_j = ε, all other parameters zero and ε² = 0, identifies a_j[p_j] with Ψ[μ_j]. This is nonzero because Ψ is injective (Proposition 7.6). Hence a_j ≠ 0."

    At t = 1 the lifts have relative weights in the cone C of the χ_i, and χ_j is an atom of C. The components of relative weight χ_j (and internal degree q_j) of the lifted actions and arrows are therefore the square-zero lifts of Lemma 6.6 for μ_j (ν1, y1), i.e. the specialization t = ε e_j; their mesh errors are λ_j R_j (zE_psi). So Ψ[μ_j] = λ_j [R_j], and λ_j ≠ 0 because μ_j is not a coboundary.

    Each μ_j is a Hochschild cocycle: the linear term of associativity in t_j.
